title: Each type at a festival dinner
caption:
Eid, Diwali or any big family dinner: the same sixteen people show up.

One brought the dish they bring every year (perfect, every year). One started the biryani debate and argued both sides. One has packed takeaway boxes for all 40 guests. Swipe to find yourself.

Send this to whoever is hosting this year. They deserve to know.
